Casey Gooby browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by enclosure pedal Casey Gooby Bag Of Dicks Published on December 8, 2009 Casey Gooby fuzz pedal Information Casey Gooby The B.O.D. fuzz pedal has captured the sound of the Jordan Bosstone and so much more. You can obtain a cool octavia vibe with the fuzz control just barely up, subtle throaty tones at the midpoint and full on in your face fuzz when dimmed. The BOD really cuts through in live situations and the sustain will travel for days.This is a unique fuzz tone; it is not a Fuzz Face, it is not a Big Muff. It is one-of-a-kind. sources.title: Gooby Bag of Dicks - Custom Built Fuzz
sources.excerpt: Gooby Bag of Dicks - Custom Built Fuzz THE GOOBY BAG OF DICKS. The Gooby Bag of Dicks is a great two knob fuzz inspired by the amazing Jordan BossTone of the late '60's. An expressive and dynamic fuzz pedal with a low noise floor. Hand built in very small numbers by Casey Gooby in the Twin Cities, Minnesota. Now gracing the pedal board of the great Billy Gibbons. $250 Pedals&Effects Home Contact Here's our demo featuring 'Shifty" Russ on a custom built 'strat' with a bucker in the bridge :
